newsitem.title: USA: EMERY AND NEW CF NOW FREIGHT.
newsitem.headline: EMERY AND NEW CF NOW FREIGHT.

text.p: Consolidated Freightways (CF), until recently a corporate sibling of Emery Worldwide, is launching a time-definite, air freight shipping operation aimed at the same door-to-door freight as Emery.
Until last December, CF was known as CF Motorways and owned by the former Consolidated Freightways Inc, also owner of Emery, a leading integrated express freight companies.
Called CF PrimeTime Air, the new division of the trucking giant will offer shippers overnight and second-day air products in addition to Consolidated's core expedited ground services.
Consolidated Freightways, Inc, spun off CF Motorways last December, and then changed its own name to CNF Transportation retaining ownership of Emery.
One stated reason for spinning off CF was that with the changing nature of shipping practices, the various CNF divisions were increasingly in competition with each other.
Current CF chief executive Roger Curry was president of Emery from 1991 to 1994.
The new CF division is offering a full menu of one- to five-day, door-to-door, air and ground service for time-definite, just-in-time delivery, as well as next-flight-out and emergency charters.
It will use established airlines rather than a dedicated fleet of aircraft, the company said.
Steve Redmond, CF's corporate manager of expedited services, heads the new division.
CF PrimeTime Air will focus on shipments over 70 pounds - as does Emery - but will not impose size or weight restrictions.
CF says it is the third largest national provider of less-than-truckload in the U.S. based on 1995 revenues of $2.1 billion. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
